title: Is there documentation on how to import and build xDrip
symptom: User pulled the project from Github, opened it with IntelliJ IDEA 2018.2.8, and after build with Build Artifacts, got error: 'Error:java: invalid target release: x'. Later, using Android Studio, got errors like 'cannot find symbol class Models' and 'package UtilityModels does not exist'.
cause: The problem is related to a comment in app/build.gradle about using a specific version of data binding until Google resolves bugs with mixed case package names. Also, updating the Android Gradle plugin when prompted can cause issues.
fix: Use Android Studio instead of IntelliJ. When opening xDrip after a clean clone, ignore the prompt to update the Android Gradle plugin. Alternatively, build from command line with 'gradlew assembledebug'.
evidence_quote: the problem you have is related to comment `// use specific version of data binding until google resolves the bugs with mixed case package names` in `app/build.gradle` when you open xDrip (after clean clone) in Android Studio it will ask you `Plugin Update Recommended: Android Gradle Plugin is ready to update.`. Ignore that otherwise you will get into troubles.
